fields.assertion_text: Por la presente, Alaska Hills Property Management, LLC verifica que el inquilino que se indica a continuación reside en la propiedad que administramos y que es responsable del pago del alquiler en el importe y con la frecuencia que se detallan a continuación.

notes._general: This document never produced a successful e2e run (no .md draft existed), so there's no BDA/LLM output to cross-check against - read directly from the image.
notes.author_relationship: Printed both as a job title under the signature ('Administradora de Propiedades') and separately as 'Relación con el inquilino: Administradora de la propiedad' in a table - the job title form is used, matching the English sibling document's convention (author_relationship = 'Property Manager', the job title).
notes.contact_information: Uses the signer's own direct phone/email at the bottom of the letter, matching the English sibling's convention, rather than the general company letterhead contact block at the top.
